FOR LANDLORDS

Keep the property
in working order.

For rental-property plumbing and heating enquiries, share the address, the problem and how access can be arranged.

Make the booking clear.

Tell Connor whether you need a plumbing repair, planned heating work or to discuss a gas safety check. Identify the person authorising the work and the contact who can arrange access.

A boiler service and a landlord gas safety check are different tasks. HSE explains landlords’ responsibilities for maintenance, annual gas safety checks and records. Check the official guidance for your property and tenancy.

For gas work, confirm current Gas Safe registration and the relevant qualifications. Do not assume an appointment is booked until the scope and availability have been agreed.

Read HSE landlord gas safety guidance ↗

Include in your enquiry.

  • Property postcode and appliance details
  • Type of work and any existing faults
  • Access contact and tenant arrangements
  • Relevant dates and authorisation for the work
